order_details.project_scope_summary: Commissioning of Auto signaling work using MSDAC for continuous track circuiting and Electronic Interlocking work at New Mugma (EI) & Mugma Yard (PI to EI) in the section Pradhankunta & Mugma (~25 km) for Dedicated Freight Corridor work in Asansol Division of Eastern Railway, in connection with Sonnagar to Andal Multitracking work
order_details.other_commercial_terms: Order awarded by a domestic entity; no promoter/promoter group/group company interest in the awarding entity; not a related party transaction
order_details.notes_caveats: This is a contract win by the Company's Wholly Owned Subsidiary (WOS) Alcon Builders and Engineers Pvt Ltd; order forms part of the Dedicated Freight Corridor project of Eastern Railway; press release dated September 12, 2026; follows earlier L1 intimation dated August 6, 2026

analysis.key_ratios:
Order Value / Annual Revenue: ₹72.48 Cr / ₹1,020 Cr = 7.1%
(Order Value (ex‑GST) / Annual Revenue) = (72.48/1020)*100 = 7.1%
analysis.materiality_assessment: The order equals roughly 7% of the company's FY24 revenue, which is a noticeable contribution but not transformative on its own.
analysis.risks: Undisclosed payment terms and margins; execution risk over 12‑month period; reliance on wholly‑owned subsidiary; potential for cost overruns; one‑time nature of the contract; no details on order book or net profit to assess cumulative impact.
analysis.rationale: At ~7% of annual revenue the contract is material enough to boost near‑term earnings if margins are healthy, yet the lack of margin and payment‑term details prevents an Excellent rating.
